ms.report:
We are pleased to submit our Final Milestone Closeout Report for Project 1300128 "Private Testnet SDK & L2 Provider Integration." This milestone summarizes the complete project achievements, challenges encountered, and lessons learned across all four development milestones.
Closeout Report:
The comprehensive closeout report documents:
・Project Achievement Summary: Docker-based private Cardano testnet infrastructure enabling developers to spin up fully-functional development environments in seconds with cardano-node, Kupo, and Ogmios
・Milestone Deliverables: All four milestones completed Research & Architecture, Core SDK Development, Documentation & Developer Onboarding, and Feature Development & Optimization
・Total Implementation: 2,047 lines of production code across Cluster.ts, Container.ts, Config.ts, Genesis.ts, and Images.ts
・Test Coverage: 49 integration tests with real Docker container testing ensuring zero reported bugs in production
・Technical Challenges & Solutions: Genesis UTxO discovery (Kupo doesn't index block 0), container startup sequencing, port conflict management, and module export ergonomics
・Lessons Learned: Real transactions beat mocked tests, Effect's typed error channels, documentation-driven development, and community feedback shaping architecture

See report for full project summary, technical architecture, and evidence of milestone completion.

Video Demonstration: https://youtu.be/9jwTqy2aXs0
